name: snRNA-seq of human retina - retinal ganglion cell subset
description: A total of 11 retinal ganglion cell clusters were identified from over 399K retinal ganglion cell nuclei in the current atlas. Utilizing previously characterized markers from macaque, 5 clusters can be annotated.
